about.title: About Anston
body: Anston is an all-in-one marketplace where anyone can buy, bid on, rent or sell almost anything, from vehicles and homes to clothes, food and services.
Anston LLC is based in Houston, Texas, and is built for buyers and sellers around the world, in more than 20 languages.

howItWorks.title: How it works
body: List an item, property or service and choose how to offer it: sell it at a fixed price, auction it, rent it out or take bookings.
Buyers find it through search and categories, message you, and pay securely on Anston.
After the deal, buyers and sellers review each other.

pricing.title: Pricing
body: Listing on Anston is free, and Anston charges sellers no selling fee. Sellers receive their price plus shipping, minus the card processing fee on their share. Prices buyers see already include Anston's service fee (7% of the seller's price under $50, 5% from $50 to $500, 3% above), so the price you see is the price you pay for the item.

Boosting is optional. Choose a percentage when you list, and your listing shows first in Featured Listings. You pay that percentage of the final price only if it sells or is booked through Anston checkout.
Any new fees will be shown clearly before you list.

items.q: What can I sell on Anston?
items.a: Almost anything legal: vehicles, homes, clothes, jewelry, furniture, equipment, homemade food that follows local rules, and services. Some items, like weapons and drugs, are not allowed.

items.q: Can I rent things out instead of selling?
items.a: Yes. When you list, choose sell, auction, rent or booking. You can choose more than one.
Payments will be made securely on Anston when checkout opens.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: This permanently deletes your Anston account. You can't undo it.
deleteAccount.point1: Your profile, photos, listings, messages, favorites and saved addresses are deleted.
deleteAccount.point2: Past orders stay in the other member's history, but your name and details are removed.
